notes: The selection manifest schema uses an external $ref to output-locator.v1.schema.json, so the generated manifest module imports the generated locator module. That direction (Omarketing extension -> generic presentation) is the one the allowlist permits; the generic registry never imports an Omarketing module.

Conditional presence (allOf/if/then/else/not/anyOf) is materialized as a Zod superRefine rather than trusted to digest equality: a stale selection requires stale_at and stale_reason, and a selected selection forbids stale_at, stale_reason and observed_sha256.
propertyNames subschemas carry string constraints without an explicit type; the generator treats that single position as a string and never infers a type from constraints elsewhere.

Observed environment side effect: the repository's own package.json prepare script runs on `pnpm exec` and re-applies `git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs`. The value is the repository's own tracked file, the entry is single and non-duplicated, and .git/config is untracked so it never enters the implementation diff or the AC-13 review. Later runs use ./node_modules/.bin/tsx to avoid re-triggering the prepare lifecycle.

Formatting is part of publishing. The generator writes both outputs and then runs the repository formatter over them, so `oxfmt --check` passes without any hand edit to a DO NOT EDIT file. The formatter is deterministic: three consecutive runs produced byte-identical outputs. Reported digests are therefore post-format digests, and a dry run reports pre-format digests and is not substitute evidence for what was published.

The generator emits a file-scoped `eslint-disable no-control-regex` only when the source schema actually matches control-character ranges. Those ranges are a security property of the contract because they reject control characters in paths, filenames, and identifiers, so the rule is narrowed for the generated file rather than weakened repository-wide.
